name: Pantheon Theme on R
creator: berb
description:
Was a bit frustrated there was no updated version of mods like this, so I made one myself.

Since I made this for myself, the song plays for 40 seconds once you land which might be a bit much for some people.

If enough people want it, I can make a shorter version.

Currently only works on these skins:
- Default
- Chosen of the Wolf

Will probably update it for more skins and make it sound better later.
